attempts.summary: Walked forward past induction guard; fired down the yard before recognizing guard behind. Turned and tried ADS optic fire, reloaded and dashed; no induction elimination. Navigated around central cover to west lane, eliminated a sentinel, approached receiver and held E. Crossed to Heart and recovered its memory while taking damage. Sprinted toward East and held E at receiver. Returned through cover toward green beacon with dash; reached 0.2 m outside floor-ring edge, moved left and fired toward yard, then died. No attempts discarded; no second deployment.

actionsAndScreenshots.actions: Read visible Mission Brief and How to Play.
actionsAndScreenshots.observations: Brief clearly explains three memories and extraction ring. Controls list movement, ADS, reload, dash, sprint and recovery. Final threat-visor paragraph extends underneath Understood button at 1280x800.

actionsAndScreenshots.actions: W advance; RMB/LMB fire; look around; R reload; Shift dash.
actionsAndScreenshots.observations: Amber optic provides clear target. Guard was behind after forward movement; bearing cue helped reveal this. Initial firing missed; no elimination claimed. Shield fell and later visibly regenerated.

actionsAndScreenshots.actions: Sprint forward; strafe around central obstruction; ADS fire on sentinel; move closer and hold E.
actionsAndScreenshots.observations: Central cover stopped forward movement; side route worked. Sentinel elimination registered. Receiver proximity prompt and floor-ring instruction guided recovery. First memory card and 01 completion shown.

actionsAndScreenshots.actions: Look and walk toward Heart; strafe and hold E; sprint toward East receiver and hold E.
actionsAndScreenshots.observations: Named markers and distances guided both recoveries. Health fell to 84 at Heart and 57 after East. Objective changed to Return to Extraction and all three slots lit.

actionsAndScreenshots.actions: Move around obstacles, sprint and dash toward beacon; turn to face yard, strafe toward ring and fire.
actionsAndScreenshots.observations: Health dropped to 18. Extraction UI gave 1.2 m then 0.2 m to edge. Several charge/recent-fire panels coexisted near center. Death occurred before upload completion; no confirmed upload percentage captured.
All three named records were accessible with short personal narratives.

findings.finding: How to Play threat-visor text is clipped under the Understood button at the tested 1280x800 view. The bottom lines cannot all be read in the screenshot.
findings.suggestion: Make handbook body scrollable or reduce its vertical footprint so every instruction remains accessible.

findings.finding: Several charge/recent-fire boxes cluster below aim during return, competing with the rifle, hit-direction arrow and extraction guidance. I could read the counts in paused images, but rapid target attribution was difficult.
findings.suggestion: Reduce overlapping central information or provide more spatial separation. This is a provisional paused-driver observation.

findings.finding: Named cyan markers, distance readouts and move-closer/floor-ring prompts supported discovering all three receivers without route knowledge.
Rain, reflective yard, cyan/amber color language and consistent typography give menus and mission a coherent visual identity.

Recoveries completed while enemies remained active, and returning with low health created visible pressure. This single attempt does not establish difficulty balance; screenshot pauses interrupt combat.

wholeGame.reason: Coherent short mission with readable objective progression and complete death/archive flow; extraction success unobserved and handbook clipping limits polish.

gameplay.reason: Movement, ADS, reload, dash, damage, shield regeneration and recovery all responded visibly. Limited accurate combat and no successful upload prevent confident depth or balance judgment.

presentation.reason: Strong consistent storm-station identity and menu treatment; basic geometric enemies and repeated structural forms remain evident.

usability.reason: Markers and proximity instructions made objectives discoverable. Handbook clipping and dense combat cueing need improvement.

readability.reason: Health/ammo/objectives and cyan markers were legible; central threat panels and small spaced technical text add reading effort.

AAA-readiness.reason: A promising visible vertical slice, but one mission attempt, clipped instructions and visibly simple asset variety do not support production-completeness confidence. This is not certification.
